description: Orphaned unit test rows with evidence_id EV_UNIT_03 causing 14 foreign key violations in ai_evidence_log and human_adjudications
resolution_details: Expunged EV_UNIT_03 rows from database; updated test_phase_4.py to use dynamic valid parent evidence_id; enforced PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON; across all services.

description: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) risk from unescaped review text and titles in Streamlit unsafe_allow_html markdown blocks
resolution_details: Applied html.escape() across review_explorer_ui.py ai_evidence_log_ui.py and opportunity_detail.py before HTML markdown interpolation.

description: Raw review CSV export in exports_reports.py failed with sqlite3.OperationalError: no such column: is_sip_relevant
reproduction_steps: Click export raw reviews in Exports & Reports page
resolution_details: Corrected query to use canonical columns: store review_created_at sip_relevance_status and mentions_sip.

description: Opportunity exemplar quotes in opportunities table were engineer summaries rather than genuine verbatim spans from eligible database records
reproduction_steps: Compare exemplar quotes in opportunities against database review texts
resolution_details: Extracted and linked 100% genuine verbatim quotes from actual eligible database records in growww_discovery.db for all 7 opportunities (OPP-01 to OPP-07). All 70 evidence checks passed.

description: Initial model validation failed Macro F1 targets due to naive substring rules in gold standard generator and missing mandate/pause patterns
resolution_details: Refined ground truth rules and added comprehensive regex patterns for bank mandate failures and SIP pause difficulty. Pain-point Macro F1 reached 0.815 (target >= 0.80) and Kappa reached 0.855 (target >= 0.70).

description: Export path traversal sanitizer failed on Windows backslash paths on POSIX environments
resolution_details: Normalized path separators via path.replace('\\' '/') before os.path.basename() sanitization.
